title: Cisco Secure Firewall (FTD) or Palo Alto NGFW: Ecosystem Fit vs Best-of-Breed
excerpt: For organisations deciding whether to stay inside the Cisco ecosystem or bring in Palo Alto. The comparison looks at integration with existing Cisco gear, the management experience and the strength of each vendor's threat research.
verdict: If your network already runs on Cisco, FTD fits naturally and reduces integration work. If you are starting from scratch, or if advanced threat analysis and a cleaner management experience are the priority, Palo Alto is usually the stronger choice.
